notes: Both arguments are bare kind-denoting plurals, so the opaque kind-level relation at (STV 0.9 0.9) is the prescribed route, with both compound genera at definitional 1.0 0.99 and the noun modifiers (sky, night) correctly left unexposed. Eat is a licensed kind-level relation head.
